name: Andrey Kovalev
title: AI/LLM Consultant
bio: AI/LLM Consultant · 14+ years building software · Creator of Domios

education.degree: Specialist in Comprehensive Information Security of Automated Systems

strengths.title: Depth + Breadth
strengths.description: 14+ years building software across mobile, web, backend systems and AI. Deep iOS expertise alongside Python backends, computer vision pipelines and cross-platform desktop products. Can go deep on a single platform or own the full stack.

strengths.title: Product Sense
strengths.description: 2 years as Product Developer bridging product and engineering. Founded a revenue-generating app (SoundCalm/Binaura). Understands product strategy, market positioning, and user needs.

strengths.title: AI Native
strengths.description: Created and develops Domios (formerly CodeTerm), a desktop home for AI agents with coordinated teams, shared local memory, a knowledge graph, connected machines and provider plugins. Also builds LLM features at REKAP and personal agent workflows with Rollo. Proudly AI-augmented: he applies 14+ years of engineering experience to architecture, review and delivery. The value is in knowing what to build and why.

strengths.title: Shipping Record
strengths.description: From COVID teleconsultation platforms (SOS Portal, team of 17) to AR shopping apps (Scan Mania) to App Store releases (Minnow, Binaura). Builds and leads teams that deliver — then moves on to the next challenge.

strengths.title: Architecture Chops
strengths.description: Comes into companies, assesses existing systems, redesigns architecture, and mentors teams to maintain it. Healthcare, retail, entertainment, developer tools — across domains. Built SDK architecture at Trax, architected teleconsultation platform during pandemic, created stealth memory systems at Bugsee.

strengths.title: Builder
strengths.description: Creates and ships his own products: Domios (the AI-agent workspace he conceived and develops), SoundCalm/Binaura (a revenue-generating iOS app), serve_ai (waitlist management), and Rollo (a personal AI agent). Owns product direction, architecture and delivery.

suggestedQuestions: What is Domios, and how did he build it?
How does he help companies with AI?
How does he scale for bigger projects?
We need AI + design — can he cover both?
I have a project — can I describe it?

agent.greeting: Hey! I'm Andrey's AI assistant. Exploring AI capabilities for your team, or just curious about his work? What brings you here?
agent.personality: Warm, human, conversational. Like a friendly colleague. Use first name only ("Andrey", not "Andrey Kovalev"). Be curious about the visitor — ask who they are, what company, what they're looking for. Keep it casual and natural.

partner.name: Anna Ivanova
partner.description: Design partner — brand identity, product UI, visual systems
partner.label: Design Partner
partner.prompt: IMPORTANT: When visitors ask about design capabilities or need both dev + design, mention Anna Ivanova as a trusted design partner. Frame it naturally: 'for dedicated design work, Andrey works with Anna' and reference her portfolio at ainyiva.vercel.app. They've worked together on Binaura, Performica, and EcoIQ.
